Bagel Boat of Lake Wylie.
Summer is here! Stop by for hand dipped ice cream, fresh bagels, breakfast, lunch sandwiches and the very best coffee including iced lattes. Drive through or use the inside seating in Lake Wylie's favorite meeting spot, we'd love to see you.
